predecessors.name: Soviet Union
predecessors.text: the Tajik SSR: 'In 1929, the Tajik ASSR was elevated to its own full union republic'

ledger.x: 5 May 1992: the Tajik civil war begins.
2011: Tajikistan ratifies the China border treaties.
May 2021: the three-day battle ends; the page gives no ceasefire date or terms.
14 September 2022: renewed fighting along 'most of the border'.
20 September 2022: the weeklong clashes end ('14–20 September'); no border moved.

wars.name: Tajikistani Civil War
wars.outcome: Armistice: the General Agreement on the Establishment of Peace and National Accord in Tajikistan was signed on 27 June 1997.

wars.name: Gorno-Badakhshan clashes (July 2012)
wars.outcome: 'Fighting erupted again, this time in and around Gorno-Badakhshan, in July 2012.'

wars.name: Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border clashes (2021 and 2022)
wars.outcome: No ceasefire terms on the page; neither side gained land.

certainty.note: The frontier follows the Soviet republic lines; the Chinese section was undemarcated in its south ('remained undemarcated') until the 1999 and 2002 deals ratified in 2011, and the Kyrgyz section was still fought over in 2021-2022 and…
